reason: The method interleaves agent token generation to resist adversarial-majority failures. The paper states its comparison uses the same decoding token budget as majority voting; its measured contribution is robustness, with no inference-cost, memory, latency, or throughput reduction. Token-level collaboration is not itself an efficiency improvement.
title: The Consensus Trap: Rescuing Multi-Agent LLMs from Adversarial Majorities via Token-Level Collaboration
